package rulefixtures

import (
	"fmt"
	"net/http"

	"github.com/go-playground/validator/v10"
)

// scenario for custom_validator_registration_inside_handler: Per-request validator registration instead of startup-time validator wiring.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.

var validate = validator.New()

func CreateUserHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	validate.RegisterValidation("custom", func(fl validator.FieldLevel) bool {
		return fl.Field().String() != ""
	})

	fmt.Fprint(w, "custom validator registered in handler")
}
